leftEvidence.title: Purified ministers prepare for returnees and separated seekers

points.label: Participants
points.left: Returnees and those separated from land practices eat.
points.right: Those returned and separated from heathen abominations eat.

points.label: Ministers
points.left: Priests and Levites are purified together.
points.right: Priests and Levites are sanctified together.

points.label: Ending
points.left: The LORD makes them joyful and turns the Assyrian king’s heart.
points.right: The feast rejoices before the Lord, who turns the king’s counsel.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Sanctified ministers and returnees keep the feast with royal support

payload.tension: The two accounts closely parallel one another while preserving their own wording and boundaries.
payload.title: Passover after captivity in Ezra and 1 Esdras
